articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Bank earnings prove there's another leg in this credit cycle. S&P Global Market Intelligence director of financial institutions research Nathan Stovall elaborates on how he envisions earnings growth for the banking sector in 2026 and what President Trump's proposed 10% rate cap on credit cards could mean for these earnings forecasts. Also watch Nathan Stovall comment on why bank stocks may be slipping despite generally positive earnings results. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination. Related tickers mentioned: BAC, C, GS, JPM, MS-PQ, WFC.
